Le détail des prestations figure au cahier des clauses techniques particulières (CCTP). L’accord-cadre fixe toutes les stipulations contractuelles. Il est exécuté au moyen de bons de commande dans les conditions fixées aux articles R. 2162-13 et R. 2162-14 du code de la commande publique. L’accord-cadre est conclu pour une durée de 4 ans ferme à compter de la date de notification. title: Driftskontrakt 3406 Solør 2027-2033
description: Innlandet fylkeskommune ved Samferdselsavdelingen inviterer til konkurranse om følgende kontraktsarbeid: Drifts- og vedlikeholdsoppgaver, med selvstendig ansvar for noen av oppgavene, på fylkesveger og fylkes- g/s-veger med tilhørende sideanlegg, sideområder, utstyr og installasjoner i kontraktsområde 3406 Solør 2027-2033. Ved motstrid mellom informasjon i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet og vedlagte dokumenter (vedlegg/bilag), gjelder informasjon i dokumentene (vedlegg/bilag) foran informasjon i konkurransegjennomføringsverktøyet. Oppdraget omfatter drifts- og vedlikeholdsoppgaver, med selvstendig ansvar for noen av oppgavene, på fylkesveger og fylkes- g/s-veger med tilhørende sideanlegg, sideområder, utstyr og installasjoner i Kongsving, Grue, Åsnes, Våler og Elverum kommuner i henhold til vegliste gitt i kap. D2-V. Vegnettet som omfattes av oppdraget består av: 673 km veg totalt hvorav 655 km fylkesveg 18 km fylkes-g/s-veg Trafikken på vegnettet varierer fra omlag ÅDT 100 til omlag ÅDT 4000. Oppdraget omfatter i hovedsak rutinemessige driftsoppgaver, og vedlikeholdsoppgaver på vegnettet. Oppdraget omfatter også tilsyn, inspeksjon og registrering, planlegging av virksomheten, beredskap mht. vinterdrift og generell trafikkavvikling, dokumentasjon, rapportering til byggherren, informasjon til publikum og håndtering av andre oppgaver som er nødvendige for drift og vedlikehold av vegnettet. Arbeidet gjøres opp etter enhetspriser. Kontrakten gjelder for perioden fra 2027-09-01 til 2033-08-31 for alle oppgavene som er beskrevet. Byggherren har opsjon på å forlenge kontrakten med 12 måneder, fra 2033-09-01 til 2034-08-31. Tilbudskonferanse vil finne sted 2026-10-02 kl. 12.00. Tilbudskonferanse vil bli gjennomført digitalt. title: LOCK AND DAM 25 NEW 1,200 FT LOCK NAVIGATION AND ECOSYSTEM SUSTAINABILITY PROGRAM (NESP)
description: NESP LD25 1200 ft Lock --------- The new lock at Lock 25 will be constructed in the downstream direction in the auxiliary miter gate bay, which has minimum provisions for an adjacent 360-foot-long lock and is referred to as Location 3 in the System Feasibility Study (September 2004). This contract will consist of construction of a new 1,200-foot drilled shaft-founded lock in the auxiliary miter gate bay, a 1,200-foot upstream ported guard wall, and a 650-foot downstream guard wall. The existing 600-foot lock will remain in place and once the new lock is constructed and operational, will become an auxiliary lock chamber used primarily by recreation traffic or when the 1,200 ft lock is out of service. ------------ SEE ATTACHMENT FOR FULL DETAILS OF UPCOMING REQUIREMENT SOLICITATION. --------- Attachment 0004 Plans (Volume 1-7) and Attachment 0005 Navisworks Federated Model must be requested via email to Contract Specialist, Whitney Dee at whitney.r.dee@usace.army.mil. title: FY27 Communications and Networking Applied Research Announcement for Office of Naval Research
description: The purpose of this announcement is to focus attention of the scientific community on (1) the area to be studied, and (2) the planned timetable for the submission of white papers and full proposals. The goal of the Communications and Networking Program within the Office of Naval Research (ONR 311) is to support the Navy's Information Warfare vision by developing measurable advances in technology that can directly enable and enhance end-to-end connectivity and quality-of-service for mission-critical information exchange among widely dispersed naval, joint, and coalition forces. The vision is to provide high throughput robust communications and networking to ensure all warfighters � from the operational command to the tactical edge � have access to information, knowledge, and decision-making necessary to perform their assigned tasks. The ONR program is interested in white papers for potential FY27 Applied Research (Budget category 6.2) projects under the following focus areas: Development of long-range VHF-band data link, using compact 4x4 Multiple-Input, Multiple-Output (MIMO) based on 5G/Commercial-Off-The Shelf (COTS) and sub-MHz frequency channelization (spectral efficiency in excess of 1 bit/Hz); Novel design and prototyping of compact electronically-steered apertures for higher frequencies (i.e., above Ka-band); Innovative approaches and technologies for low probability-of-detection communications against advanced electronic threats; Advanced techniques for distributed network control, synchronization, and/or scheduling; and New algorithms for predicting network behavior/performance or emerging operational requirements that are translated into traffic engineering policies. The ONR is receptive to innovative ideas, which are not within the above focus areas, but nonetheless are important to the Navy/Marine Corps communications and networking, as otherwise described in this Topic Description

title: Germany – Construction work – DSP - Pumpenhaus Scharnhorststraße Dezentral
description: Das Projekt DSP – Dezentral Scharnhorststraße Pumpenhaus ist eine Infrastrukturmaßnahme zur Erweiterung und Modernisierung des Heizwerks Scharnhorststraße. Am Standort Scharnhorststraße wird eine neue Wärmeübertragerstation mit zwei Pumpengruppen, Rohrleitungssystemen sowie den erforderlichen elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen in einer „Brownfield-Umgebung“ errichtet. Die Umsetzung erfolgt innerhalb eines bestehenden Heizwerksstandortes in einer Brownfield-Umgebung. Neben der Errichtung neuer Anlagenkomponenten sind zahlreiche Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Anlagen, Rohrleitungssystemen, elektro- und leittechnischen Einrichtungen sowie betrieblichen Prozessen zu berücksichtigen. Besonderes Augenmerk liegt dabei auf der Aufrechterhaltung der Versorgungssicherheit und die Umsetzung aller relevanten Umschlussarbeiten innerhalb eines drei (3) monatigen Stillstandsfensters. Für die Umsetzung des Projektes werden in einem vorgelagerten Projekt bereits die erforderlichen Voraussetzungen zur Baufeldfreimachung geschaffen. Aufbauend darauf umfasst das Projekt DSP die Ausführungsplanung, Beschaffung, Errichtung, Inbetriebsetzung und Übergabe der neuen Anlagentechnik einschließlich aller hierfür erforderlichen Nebenleistungen. Auszuführende Arbeiten: • Montage und Umbau von Fernwärme-Anlagenkomponenten • Installation und Integration von Pumpensystemen mit elektrischer Antriebstechnik • Rohrleitungsbau für Fernwärmeanwendungen einschließlich Verbindung und Einbindung von Anlagenteilen (Nennweiten ca. DN 200 bis DN 600) • Anbindung neuer Rohrleitungen und Komponenten an bestehende Versorgungs- und Rohrleitungssysteme • Lieferung und Montage von Armaturen, Regel- und Absperreinrichtungen (Nennweiten ca. DN 250 bis DN 600) • Planung und Errichtung von Rohrleitungsbefestigungen sowie unterstützenden Stahlbaukonstruktionen • Einbindung bestehender Anlagenkomponenten in neu errichtete Systeme • Herstellung von Fundamenten für Anlagen- und Stahlbaukomponenten • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Niederspannungs-, Energieversorgungs- und Antriebssystemen • Anpassung und Erweiterung von Mess-, Steuerungs- und Leittechnik • Erneuerung elektrischer Energieversorgungsanlagen einschließlich Kabelverlegung • Demontage und Rückbau bestehender Anlagen- und Rohrleitungskomponenten (Nennweiten bis ca. DN 500) Die Anbindungen an das Netz erfolgen auf dem Betriebsgelände. Die oberirdische Zuführung der beiden DN500 Leitungen auf dem Betriebsgelände auf einem bestehenden Stahlbau gehört zum Projektumfang. Die vorhandene und zu erweiternde Leittechnik ist auf dem Betriebsgebäude verortet. Die Planung der E- und Leittechnik sind Bestandteil vom Projektumfang. Schnittstellen zur bestehenden E- und Leittechnik sind vorhanden und zu berücksichtigen.

title: Belgium – Architectural, construction, engineering and inspection services – 6.25.1.9 Mission d’auteur de projet pour la restauration des façades du Musée Art et Histoire dans le Parc du Cinquantenaire à Bruxelles – Marché de services - Procédure ouverte
description: Le présent marché porte sur l’étude de la restauration des façades du Musée Art et Histoire sur le site du Cinquantenaire à Bruxelles. La Régie des Bâtiments a déjà rénové les autres façades du site. Dès lors, l’étude en vue de la restauration des façades extérieures et des façades des cours intérieures du Musée Art et Histoire du Cinquantenaire est opportune pour la cohérence de l’ensemble. Ces façades sont classées, voir Arrêté de classement du 22.04.2004 en annexe 04. Le marché vise les études complètes en vue de - la restauration des façades du Musée Art et d’Histoire (voir périmètre en annexe), y compris les statues, les lettrages, etc. - la faisabilité de la mise aux normes incendie en façade des bâtiments et d’un chemin d’évacuation supplémentaire au rez-de-chaussée pour l’Horeca actuel - la restauration de l’hémicycle du Musée Art et Histoire - étudier et proposer des possibilités d’intégration et/ou de reconversion de l’ancienne entrée de l’esplanade du Musée Art & Histoire, en vue de renforcer sa visibilité et d’en faire un véritable espace de mise en valeur des activités et collections du Musée. Pour plus d'information voir le cahier spécial des charges en annexe à cet avis de marché.

title: Switzerland – High-voltage cable – Herstellung, Lieferung, Montage und Prüfung von zwei temporären HS-Kabelanlagen im Unterwerk Leibstadt 380 kV
description: Fourniture, montage et mise en service de deux installations temporaires de câbles haute tension (HT) au poste de transformation de Leibstadt 380 kV Le présent marché comprend principalement les prestations suivantes : * Ingénierie de l'ensemble de l'installation de câbles, y compris la définition d'une protection mécanique optimale ; * Fabrication et fourniture des câbles, accessoires et terminaisons * Mesures et contrôles des câbles sur site ; * Fabrication, essais en usine et transport des câbles ; * Dimensionnement, fourniture et installation de la protection mécanique des câbles ; * Pose et montage des installations de câbles avec l'ensemble des fixations et accessoires requis ; * Dimensionnement, fourniture et montage des structures support des terminaisons ; * Fourniture des informations techniques nécessaires au dimensionnement des fondations (réalisées par un tiers) ; * Dimensionnement, fourniture et montage des terminaisons haute tension ; * Fourniture et installation du matériel de mise à la terre ; * Réalisation des essais et contrôles sur site ; * Élaboration de la documentation de l'installation conformément aux exigences de Swissgrid (ZSTD-25-310) ; * Démontage complet de l'installation de câbles en fin d'utilisation, élimination des accessoires, enroulement individuel des câbles sur tourets ; * Transport et déchargement des câbles au magasin central de Swissgrid (emplacement à définir) Option * Afin de garantir la capacité de transport de courant permanent la plus élevée possible, le fournisseur devra proposer un concept de pose optimisé, résistant aux courts-circuits, associé à une protection mécanique optimisée des câbles. Le fournisseur devra démontrer et justifier la capacité de transport maximale atteignable de l'installation proposée.

title: DoDEA Daily Commute Student Transportation Services to the Hohenfels Military Community, Germany
description: 1. Purpose Pursuant to Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 10, the Department of Defense Education Activity (DoDEA) Procurement Office is currently conducting market research to identify companies capable of and qualified to provide Daily Commute (DC) student bus transportation services in support of the Hohenfels Military Community in Germany. This Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for conducting market research and does not constitute a Request for Proposals (RFP), Invitation for Bids (IFB), Request for Quotations (RFQ), and does not obligate the Government to any current or future commitments. 2. Scope of Work (Draft) DoDEA is seeking full student transportation services to the Hohenfels Military Community in Germany. Prospective contractor shall all personnel including drivers, safety attendant, supervision, services, supplies, and/or equipment necessary to perform student transportation services. Contracted services shall comply with DoDEA and Host Nation requirements for student transportation. Please see the attached draft copy of the PWS attached to this RFI for more information. Please note that the draft PWS is subject to change up until the solicitation is issued. The period of performance for these services are anticipated to start on 01 August 2026. For purposes of this acquisition, the North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code is 485410, School and Employee Bus Transportation, Size Standard, $30.0M. The Product Service Code (PSC) is V222, Transportation/Travel/Relocation/Travel/Lodging/Recruitment: Passenger Motor Charter. 4. Requested Information If your company is interested, capable, and qualified to provide these services, please submit the following: a. Statement of Interest Please indicate your interest in participating in this potential requirement. b. Capability Statement (Maximum of 3 pages) Please a brief description of your company�s qualifications, relevant experience, and technical capabilities to meet the draft scope of work. Include: Company name, address, and point of contact CAGE/NCAGE code and Unique Entity ID (UEI) Business size and socio-economic status (e.g. small business, 8(a), HUBZone), if applicable Relevant past performance examples c. Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) Please submit a non-binding ROM cost estimate based on the draft scope. This estimate is for planning purposes only and will not be considered a formal quote. Please see the attached Request for Information - Sources Sought Notice document for more details. 4. Submission Instructions Submissions and inquiries pertaining to this RFI must be sent electronically to Esther.Yi@dodea.edu no later than 11:00AM Eastern Standard Time (EST) on 17 November 2025. Vendor�s email message shall state �HE125426REHOHENFELS� in the subject line. Telephone calls regarding this RFI will not be accepted. 5. Disclaimer This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs incurred in responding to this notice. Please note that vendors are required to be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at the time an offer/quotation/proposal is due to comply with the annual representations and certifications requirements. Therefore, only businesses with an active SAM registration will be eligible to receive any resultant contract(s) with the Department of Defense Education Activity.

title: Travaux de construction - Sous-station Handeck
description:

  • Construction du nouveau bâtiment de la sous-station : travaux d'excavation, bétonnage sur place, utilisation d'éléments préfabriqués, carottages
  • Construction de nouvelles installations de câblage avec puits et canaux de câbles (enterrées)
  • Raccordements à l'eau et aux eaux usées, système d'infiltration

title: Switzerland – Environmental services – Projekt Mitholz: Probenahme und Messungen an Grundwasser und Oberflächengewässern 2027-2037
description: Dans le cadre du projet «élimination des munitions de l’ancien dépôt de Mitholz», d’importants travaux de construction seront réalisés au cours des quelque 20 prochaines années. Le périmètre du projet se situe sur un site contaminé inscrit au cadastre des sites contaminés du DDPS (KbS DDPS). Afin de protéger les eaux souterraines et de surface, une surveillance continue des eaux est mise en place conformément au concept de surveillance (annexe du cahier des charges). Celle-ci comprend notamment un échantillonnage régulier et des mesures des paramètres de terrain des stations de mesure des eaux souterraines, des sources et des cours d’eau, suivis d’analyses en laboratoire. En fonction de l’avancement des travaux et en cas de nécessité d’intervention, des mesures et des échantillonnages supplémentaires seront effectués. De plus, des études complémentaires peuvent s’avérer nécessaires pour répondre à des questions d’ordre hydrogéologique et relatives aux sites contaminés. L’appel d’offres porte sur les travaux de terrain liés à la surveillance des eaux ainsi et aux études complémentaires en matière d’hydrogéologie et de sites contaminés pour la période 2027-2037. Les prestations comprennent notamment: • des échantillonnages par pompage et par puisage dans les stations de mesure des eaux souterraines et les piézomètres ; • des échantillonnages et mesures de débit au niveau des sources et des cours d’eau ; • la saisie des paramètres de terrain, des mesures de niveau et des niveaux d’eau ; • la coordination de l'analyse des échantillons avec les laboratoires mandatés ; • la coordination des travaux avec les mandataires spécialisés concernés du thème transversal QT91 « Études techniques et gestion environnementale ». La mission porte principalement sur la réalisation de campagnes de mesures et d’échantillonnages conformément au suivi de base (annexe 1) tous les sept mois, portant alternativement sur 19 et 39 stations de mesure (16 piézomètres, 11 sources, 9 eaux de surface) sur la période 2027-2037.

title: Office of Hazardous Materials Safety Research Initiative � FY2026 BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT (BAA)
description: AMENDMENT 01 (08/24/2026): The purpose of this amendment is to (1) change the Phase I White Paper due date from December 22, 2026, to November 18, 2026, and (2) add the contact email address tremayne.terry@dot.gov to Section X.A. in Attachment 1- BAA Solicitation_PHMSA-26HM-BAA. All other terms and conditions of the solicitation remain unchanged. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT), Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration (PHMSA), Office of Hazardous Materials Safety (OHMS), is soliciting white papers and full proposals under Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) PHMSA-26HM-BAA pursuant to FAR 35.016. The objective of this announcement is to award competitive research contracts that advance scientific, technical, engineering, and policy solutions to prevent incidents and enhance safety during the transportation of hazardous materials across all modes. Offerors are invited to submit innovative research proposals addressing one or more of the following core topic areas: 26HM-ESS (Efficient Safety Standards): Research to modernize safety standards and testing, streamline certification, leverage safety data, and evaluate risk landscapes to reduce regulatory burden while maintaining safety. 26HM-SST (Safe Energy Storage Technologies): Research assessing transportation risks of energy storage systems, battery chemistries, thermal runaway detection and mitigation, and critical mineral recovery. 26HM-IPG (Innovative Packaging): Development and evaluation of advanced packaging materials, containment designs, integrity monitoring, and predictive failure simulations. 26HM-RER (Risk Reduction for Emergency Response): Innovations, technologies, data analysis, and materials to enhance emergency responder safety, communication, and preparedness. 26HM-RTS (Hazardous Materials Rail Transportation Safety): Research advancing scientific understanding of rail tank car performance under derailment conditions, crashworthiness materials, thermal shielding, and predictive risk modeling. A two-phase selection process (Phase I: White Paper; Phase II: Invited Full Proposal) will be used. Awards will be procurement contracts (Firm-Fixed-Price or Cost-Reimbursement) up to $2,000,000 with a total performance period of up to 36 months. Full eligibility, formatting, and submission instructions are detailed in the solicitation document attached to this notice.

title: Primer Feed Mechanisms (PFMs)
description: The U.S. Army Contracting Command - New Jersey, on behalf of the office of the Project Manager, Combat Ammunition Systems (PM CAS), intends to issue a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Primer Feed Mechanisms (PFMs) in support of the M777A2 155mm Howitzer. The PFM Assembly consists of three assemblies: (1) Body Assembly, (2) Tray Assembly, and (3) Magazine Assembly, and each assembly consists of several sub-assemblies. In addition to the PFM Assembly, the Dog Coupler Assembly (legacy), Reinforced Dog Coupler Assembly, Magazine Primer Stop, Injector Arm Assembly, Firing Pin, Cross Pin, and Inert Primers are considered down parts to the overarching PFM assemblies.Specifications: The contractor shall manufacture, test, and deliver Primer Feed Mechanism (PFM) assemblies and associated components for the M777A2 Lightweight 155mm Howitzer to support U.S. or Foreign Military Sales customers. Specific detailed packaging instructions will be included on the delivery order on a case-by-case basis.Planned Acquisition: The Government intends to award a single, five-year Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract with Firm Fixed Price (FFP) delivery orders with five one-year Ordering Periods (OPs) from Fiscal Year (FY) 27-32. The production contract award will be based upon Full and Open Competition as a 100% Small Business Set Aside, in accordance with FAR 19.5.The following Ordering Periods are anticipated:OP 1: 12 months from date of awardOP 2: 12 months from the end of OP 1OP 3: 12 months from the end of OP 2OP 4: 12 months from the end of OP 3OP 5: 12 months from the end of OP 4. **This is a notice that Solicitation W15QKN-26-R-A044 is being placed on hold until further notice. The Government will provide notice when the solicitation is active again. For administrative purposes, the closing date is extended to November 18, 2026, to prevent system closure. Proposal submission is not required until further notice.**

The anticipated period of performance is from January 01, 2026 to December 11, 2026 with three one-year option periods. The applicable North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code assigned to this procurement is 339112- Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing with a small business size standard of 1,000 employees. description: Les 12 AC Patrimoine ont pour vocation de réaliser les travaux d’entretien des bâtiments et de la voirie du Centre de Cadarache pour : o assurer la sécurité des personnes et des biens, o permettre la rénovation et/ou l’aménagement des locaux soumis au code du travail, o permettre la rénovation et/ou l’aménagement des locaux classés Etablissement Recevant du Public (ERP), permettre d’atteindre les objectifs du CEA : o adéquation entre la politique patrimoniale du Centre de Cadarache et les travaux, o amélioration de la gestion et du suivi des travaux d’entretien, o optimisation des coûts et délais d’exécution des travaux, apporter aux installations du centre le support technique nécessaire. Ces prestations sont réparties en 12 lots techniques qui feront l’objet d’Accords–Cadres distincts. Les travaux, organisés par lots définis infra, feront l’objet d’une mise en place d’Accords-Cadres (AC) mono-attributaires, dits « accords-cadres locaux » (limités au Centre CEA de Cadarache), conclus : o pour une durée de 4 ans, o sans minimum, o avec un montant maximum plafond par lot qui n’est pas un engagement de dépenses – Montants définis par lot (voir les Projets d’AC de chacun des lots), o s’exécutant au fur et à mesure des besoins via l’émission par le CEA d’Ordres de Services (OS) pour les bons de commande et/ou les marchés subséquents (dits « Accords-Cadres mixtes »). Chiffrage des OS via un "BPU" et les "Autres prix applicables" (pour les taux horaires et coefficients majorateurs applicables). Parmi les 12, le lot 4 uniquement, est un Accord-Cadre classifié « secret » avec accès au sens de l’arrêté du 9 Août 2021 portant approbation de l’instruction générale interministérielle n° 1300 sur la protection du secret de la défense nationale. Il ne nécessite pas la détention d’informations et/ou de supports classifiés par le titulaire dans ses locaux.

title: Netherlands – Business travel services – Europese Openbare Aanbesteding Dienstreizen (vervoer en verblijf)
description: De aanbestedende dienst wil middels deze aanbesteding op rechtmatige wijze een raamovereenkomst sluiten met één (1) dienstverlener (intermediairsfunctie) voor de bemiddeling van vervoer (vlieg- en/of internationale treinticket) en verblijven ten behoeve van medewerkers van aanbestedende dienst. Dit wil zeggen één dienstverlener, één tussenpersoon, één (service)loket en één eenduidig en integraal (financieel en operationeel) proces ter ondersteuning van de organisatie van vervoer- en verblijfsfaciliteiten. Dit met als doelstellingen: Vervoer- en verblijfsfaciliteiten buiten Nederland efficiënt, duurzaam en rechtmatig in te kopen; Flexibiliteit en ontzorging te kunnen bieden aan haar medewerkers; Het realiseren van een optimale prijs- kwaliteitverhouding; Het realiseren van een optimaal passend aanbod met betrekking tot vervoer- en verblijfsfaciliteiten. Binnen de scope van de opdracht valt: Het opstellen van vervoer- en verblijfsvoorstellen in het buitenland voor één (1) of meerdere reizigers; Het verstrekken van informatie over het reserveren, boeken, wijzigen en annuleren van vervoer, verblijf en aanverwante diensten; Het leveren van internationale vlieg- en treintickets, inclusief flexibele boekingsvoorwaarden indien deze door de betreffende vervoerder worden aangeboden; Het verzorgen van verblijfreserveringen en bijbehorende vouchers of bevestigingen; Het verstrekken van reisdocumenten en relevante informatie over vervoer- en verblijfsvoorwaarden; Het bieden van ondersteuning bij calamiteiten tijdens reizen (vervoer) en verblijven in het buitenland en het zoveel mogelijk oplossen van de gevolgen daarvan; Het beschikbaar stellen van een 24-uurs bereikbaarheidsdienst; Het factureren van vervoer- en verblijfsdiensten; Het implementeren en onderhouden van de voor de dienstverlening benodigde processen en systemen; Het leveren van managementinformatie en periodieke rapportages; Het signaleren van actuele reisadviezen, bijvoorbeeld op basis van de reisadviezen van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken. Buiten de scope van de opdracht valt: Vergaderlocaties en bijbehorende faciliteiten, zoals catering, in binnen- en buitenland; Reizen en verblijven binnen Nederland, waaronder treinreizen, busreizen, taxivervoer, openbaar vervoer en binnenlandse verblijffaciliteiten.

title: Etablering, drift og vedlikehold av døgnhvileplass langs E134/E18 Kongsberg-Asker
description: Statens vegvesen har behov for ca. 100 oppstillingsplasser på strekningen E134 Kongsberg–Drammen og E18 Drammen–Asker. Det er estimert et behov på ca. 70 oppstillingsplasser på E18 Drammen–Asker og ca. 30 oppstillingsplasser på E134 Kongsberg–Drammen. Oppdragsgiver forbeholder seg retten til å justere fordelingen noe mellom strekningene innenfor totalen basert på tilbudt løsning og tilgjengelige arealer. Det kan være aktuelt å inngå kontrakt med flere leverandører og/eller dele anskaffelsen opp i ulike delkontrakter. Hver enkelt døgnhvileplass skal minimum ha oppstillingsplasser til 15 vogntog og skal inneholde serviceanlegg med toalett, dusj og ladestasjoner. Ellers skal døgnhvileplassen oppfylle de skal-krav som er opplistet i punkt 3.2. Oppdragsgiver foretrekker store døgnhvileplasser. Døgnhvileplassen skal være klar til åpning senest 24 måneder etter at kontrakten er signert og kontrakten gjelder i 10 år fra åpningstidspunktet. Oppdragsgiver har opsjon på å forlenge avtalen med 1+1 år, slik at total mulig leieperiode blir 12 år. Ladeinfrastrukturen skal være ferdig utbygd og i drift I henhold til punkt 3.2 t. Det vil bli avholdt elektronisk tilbudskonferanse på Teams den 21.092026 klokka 12:00. Påmelding til tilbudskonferansen gjøres ved å sende navn og e-postadresse via kommunikasjonskanalen (melding) i KGV innen 18.09.2026 klokka 12:00.

title: Norway – Real estate services – Establishment, operation and maintenance of a 24 hour resting place along the E134/E18 Kongsberg-Asker
description: The Norwegian Public Roads Administration needs approx. 100 parking spaces on the stretch E134 Kongsberg-Drammen and E18 Drammen-Asker. It is estimated that there is a need for approx. 70 parking places on the E18 Drammen-Asker and approx. 30 parking places on the E134 Kongsberg-Drammen. The contracting authority reserves the right to adjust the distribution somewhat between the sections within the total, based on the offered system and available areas. It may be necessary to enter into a contract with several tenderers and/or divide the procurement into different sub-contracts. Each individual 24 hour resting place shall as a minimum have parking places for 15 wagon trains and shall include a service facility with toilets, showers and charging stations. Otherwise, the 24 hour resting place shall fulfil the shall-requirements listed in point 3.2. The Contracting Authority prefers large 24 hour resting places. The 24 hour resting place shall be ready for opening at the latest 24 months after the contract has been signed and the contract will apply for 10 years from the opening hours. The contracting authority has the option to extend the contract for 1+1 year, so that the total possible lease period is 12 years. The charging infrastructure shall be completely developed and in operation in accordance with point 3.2 h. An electronic tender conference will be held for Teams 21.092026 (12:00). Registration for the tender conference will be done by sending the name and email address via the communication channel (message) in KGV by 18.09.2026 at 12:00.

title: Denmark – Safety consultancy services – Managed Detection and Response (MDR)
description: Med henblik på at beskytte Statens IT (Ordregiver) mod aktuelle og fremtidige cybertrusler anvender Ordregiver en række sikkerhedsteknologier, herunder en Extended Detection and Response (XDR)-platform. XDR-platformen understøtter indsamling, korrelation og analyse af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser på tværs af Ordregivers it-miljø med henblik på at beskytte systemer, tjenester og data samt sikre dataenes fortrolighed, integritet og tilgængelighed. Henset hertil udbyder Ordregiver en kontrakt, hvis formål er at understøtte og styrke Ordregivers egen operative it-sikkerhed gennem levering af en Managed Detection and Response (MDR)-tjeneste fra et Security Operations Center (SOC). MDR-tjenesten skal anvende og supplere Ordregivers XDR-platform med døgnbemandet overvågning, analyse, detektion, validering, eskalering og håndtering af sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesten skal leveres 24 timer i døgnet, 365 dage om året, og bidrage til hurtig identifikation, vurdering og håndtering af cybertrusler og sikkerhedshændelser. Tjenesteydelserne udgør et væsentligt element i Ordregivers fortsatte modnings- og udviklingsproces på cybersikkerhedsområdet med fokus på teknologi, processer, kompetencer og samarbejde på tværs af interne og eksterne interessenter. Med udbuddet ønsker Ordregiver adgang til en professionel MDR-tjeneste, der kan imødekomme Ordregivers høje krav til kvalitet, robusthed og effektivitet, samt en leverandør, der løbende kan indgå i dialog med Ordregiver om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed, herunder trusselsbilledet, teknologiske muligheder, automatisering, kompetenceudvikling og løbende forbedringer af sikkerhedsniveauet. Leverandøren skal gennemføre en teknisk, organisatorisk og processuel Transition Ind, der sikrer, at de løbende MDR-ydelser kan leveres fra overgang til driftsfasen. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at Ordregiver har indgået kontrakt med to (2) leverandører til varetagelse af Ordregivers eksisterende XDR-platform, som leverandøren skal samarbejde med i forbindelse med Transition Ind. Som led heri skal leverandøren etablere og konfigurere de nødvendige integrationer mellem Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige relevante sikkerhedskilder samt leverandørens værktøjer og platforme, der anvendes til kontraktens opfyldelse. Leverandøren skal levere Løbende MDR-ydelser; herunder kontinuerlig overvågning, analyse, korrelation, validering og detektion af alarmer og sikkerhedshændelser. Leverandøren skal foretage triagering og kvalificering af alarmer med henblik på at identificere reelle sikkerhedshændelser samt sikre rettidig eskalering og advisering i overensstemmelse med aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. Disse løbende MDR-ydelser omfatter herunder: • Kontinuerlig SOC-overvågning af sikkerhedsrelaterede hændelser og alarmer. • Analyse, korrelation og kvalificering af hændelser på tværs af relevante datakilder. • Identifikation, detektion og validering af sikkerhedshændelser. • Udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende optimering af detektionsregler, use cases og analysemodeller. • Anvendelse af relevant Threat Intelligence til understøttelse af detektions- og analysearbejdet. • Løbende vurdering af trusselsbilledet og dets relevans for Ordregivers miljø. • Proaktiv identifikation af potentielle sikkerhedshændelser og sikkerhedsrisici, herunder gennem Threat Hunting-aktiviteter. • Eskalering, advisering og rapportering af sikkerhedshændelser i henhold til aftalte processer og serviceniveauer. • Vedligeholdelse af eksisterende integrationer samt etablering af nye integrationer efter behov. • Optimering og videreudvikling af Ordregivers XDR-platform og øvrige sikkerhedsløsninger. • Rådgivning vedrørende udvikling og modning af Ordregivers sikkerhedsorganisation, sikkerhedsprocesser og governance. • Gennemførelse af målrettede Threat Hunting-forløb og analyser af mistænkelige aktiviteter. • Incident Response-bistand ved sikkerhedshændelser efter rekvisition fra Ordregiver, herunder analyse, afgrænsning, håndtering, afhjælpning og genopretning. • Bistand ved større sikkerhedshændelser, cyberkriser og koordination med relevante interessenter. • Sikkerhedsfaglig rådgivning og strategisk sparring om udviklingen inden for cybersikkerhed. Kontrakten omfatter desuden tværgående ydelser, herunder dokumentation, rapportering, governance, kvalitetssikring og informationssikkerhed, der leveres gennem hele kontraktperioden. Endvidere omfatter kontrakten forpligtelser ved kontraktophør (Transition Ud), der skal sikre en kontrolleret, sikker og dokumenteret overdragelse af viden, data, processer, integrationer og øvrige kontraktrelaterede leverancer til Ordregiver eller en efterfølgende leverandør.

title: Request for Proposals (RFP) - BARDA Vaccine Medical Countermeasures for Pandemic Influenza Preparedness & Response
description: BARDA seeks Contractor(s) to support the continuation of the Vaccine Medical Counermeasures (MCM's) for Pandemic Influenza Preparedness and Response Program. Contractors will furnish all the necessary services, qualified personnel, materials, supplies, equipment and facilities (U.S. facilities preferred) not otherwise provided by the USG as needed to provide MCMs, such as vaccines, antigens, and adjuvants, for pandemic preparedness and response or as required in response to a public health emergency; produce antigen and vaccines against influenza virus or other viruses with pandemic potential as required by BARDA; produce antigens, adjuvants, and/or vaccines to support USG efforts to further improve influenza vaccines (for which feasibility data is available); and support rapid regulatory decisions and manufacturing readiness by generating and submitting to FDA all relevant data (e.g., analytical, nonclinical, clinical, and/or chemistry, manufacturing, and controls (CMC)), including data generated during interpandemic periods. Mandatory Qualification Requirements: To be eligible for award, the Offeror must produce vaccines against influenza and influenza strains with pandemic potential; must demonstrate a successful experience in the manufacturing of influenza vaccine by: 1. Holding a U.S. influenza vaccine license; or 2. Have developed an influenza vaccine as evidenced by: a. Submission of a Biologics License Application (BLA) for seasonal or pandemic influenza vaccine Please see full solicitation details and proposal submission instructions detailed in attachments 01-19 of this notice.

title: Replacement throttle valve 3601 - as part of the Refurbishment of the Handeck 3 – Rotlaui drive water system
description:
Kraftwerke Oberhasli AG intends to drain the headwater tunnel in the summer of 2028 as part of the Handeck 3 headwater system refurbishment project. During this period, extensive maintenance work will be carried out, including in the Rotlaui throttle valve chambers. The DK 3601 throttle valve, which dates from 1953, is to be replaced by a new safety throttle valve. The access door to the valve chamber is a particular constraint in this regard.


This tender covers the design (engineering, dimensioning), manufacture and transport of the new butterfly valve, Ø2.1 m, complete with operating seal, closing weight and oil-filled servo motor.

description: This is a pre-solicitation synopsis for a Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC), Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (ID/IQ) for Remedial Action efforts at the Welsbach/General Gas Mantle (GGM) Superfund Site located in Camden County, NJ. The SATOC will provide the Government with a continuity of personnel and institutional knowledge for developing a streamlined response and flexible vehicle for cost-effective soils remediation. It may require, but is not limited to, designs, interim actions, remedial actions, short-term operation and maintenance, laboratory management, reports, and any other actions necessary to implement the soils remedy at the Welsbach/GGM Site.We intend to issue the SATOC solicitation around 15 December 2025. The planned capacity of this SATOC will be $95 Million. Task orders will utilize a cost plus fixed fee contract type. The solicitation will be set aside for Small Business concerns and will utilize source selection procedures described in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Subpart 15.3. title: Germany – Real estate services – Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR) Funkhausareal Südteil | Munich Media Hub (MMH)
description: Weiterentwicklung und Realisierung eines Medien-, Veranstaltungs-, Büro-, Studio- und Mobilitätscluster ----------------------------------------------------------- Gegenstand des Vorhabens ist die Weiterentwicklung des Südteils des Funkhausareals in München am Rundfunkplatz zu einem Medien-, Veranstaltungs-, Büro-, Studio- und Mobilitätscluster durch einen im Vergabeverfahren auszuwählenden Projektpartner. Der BR bleibt im Südteil Grundstückseigentümer und soll dort als Leitnutzer und Impulsgeber sichtbar bleiben. Er erfüllt damit auch die Anforderungen aus der Gemeinbedarfsbindung des Bebauungsplans Nr. 937 der Landeshauptstadt München, in dessen Umgriff die zu entwickelnden bzw. zu überplanenden Grundstücke liegen. Das Vorhaben umfasst – nach Durchführung der vorgesehenen und zur Realisierung des Vorhabens auch erforderlichen Realteilung der derzeit ungeteilten Flächen – mehrere Grundstücke im Südteil des Hochhausareals. Grundlage für die räumliche Einordnung ist der im „kleinen“ Datenraum bereitgestellte vorläufige Realteilungsplan. Die endgültige Grundstücks-, Erbbaurechts-, Dienstbarkeits- und Schnittstellenstruktur wird im weiteren Verfahren auf Grundlage der freigegebenen Plan- und Vertragsunterlagen konkretisiert. Die Vorhabenbeschreibung sieht die Bestellung zweier Erbbaurechte auf noch real zu teilenden Flächen vor. Der spätere Erbbauberechtigte soll das unternehmerische Risiko der mit den Erbbaurechten verknüpften Verpflichtungen zu genehmigungsfähiger Planung, Bau, Sanierung, Vermietung, Betrieb, Bewirtschaf-tung, Instandhaltung, Finanzierung und Schnittstellensteuerung im vertraglich festgelegten Umfang tragen. Das Verfahren umfasst drei Auftragsbestandteile: • Auftragsbestandteil 1: Veranstaltungsbereich („Erbbaurecht 1“). • Auftragsbestandteil 2: Hochhaus („Erbbaurecht 2“). • Auftragsbestandteil 3: Tiefgarage (eigentums- bzw. erbbaurechtsübergreifend). --- Gegenstand des geplanten wettbewerblichen Dialogs ist keine isolierte Bau- oder Sanierungsleistung, sondern die vertragliche Strukturierung, Entwicklung, Finanzierung, bauliche Realisierung, Vermietung, Bewirtschaftung und Instandhaltung von drei eng miteinander verzahnten Teilprojekten. Der BR kann im Dialog auch Finanzierungsvarianten, Finanzierungsunterstützungen oder eine eigene Finanzierungskomponente prüfen, soweit dies vergaberechtlich zulässig, wirtschaftlich vorteilhaft und mit dem angestrebten Gesamtsystem vereinbar ist. Eine Finanzierungszusage des BR wird jedoch ausdrücklich nicht erteilt. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die nähere Beschreibung der Maßnahme und die Bedingungen zur Teilnahme entnehmen Sie den Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere den Dokumenten "BR_MMH_Vorhabenbeschreibung" und "BR_MMH_Bewerbungsbedingungen und Verfahrensbeschreibung". --- Darin ist auch die Aufwandsentschädigung für die Teilanahme an der Dialogphase umfassend geregelt.

title: Romania – Feasibility study, advisory service, analysis – Servicii de proiectare faza studiu de fezabilitate (S.F.), conform H.G. nr. 907/2016, pentru proiectul de investiţie imobiliară: „Bază integrată de instruire pentru forțele cu destinație specială din Armata României în cazarma 3645 Mihai Bravu”, cod proiect 2025-I-3645
description: Serviciile care fac obiectul contractului sunt: – Studiu de Fezabilitate pentru obiectivul „Bază integrată de instruire pentru forţele cu destinaţie specială din Armata României în cazarma 3645 Mihai Bravu", conform H.G. nr. 907/2016, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare, în conformitate cu tema de proiectare; – Nota de prezentare, elaborată conform conţinutului-cadru prevăzut în Anexa nr. 4 a Regulamentului privind organizarea şi funcţionarea Consiliului tehnico-economic al Ministerului Apărării Naţionale, aprobat prin Ordinul M.94/2017; – Studiu topografic în sistem STEREO 70; – Studiu geotehnic, verificat de verificator de proiecte atestat Af; – Studiu hidrogeologic; – Studiu balistic, necesar pentru fundamentarea soluţiilor de amenajare şi de siguranţă aferente obiectelor de instrucţie cu tragere (poligoane de tragere, shooting house, poligoane de antrenament), inclusiv stabilirea zonelor de siguranţă şi a soluţiilor de captare/oprire a proiectilelor; – Studiu de obstacolare şi documentaţia aferentă obţinerii avizului Autorităţii Aeronautice Civile Române (A.A.C.R.), necesar în raport cu heliportul prevăzut în cadrul obiectivului şi cu servituţile aeronautice aplicabile amplasamentului; – Studiu de circulaţie, necesar pentru fundamentarea soluţiilor de acces, a drumurilor şi platformelor interioare şi a legăturii cu reţeaua de drumuri existentă; – Studiu de soluţie şi de coexistenţă, necesar pentru racordarea la reţelele de utilităţi şi pentru stabilirea condiţiilor de coexistenţă cu reţelele şi obiectivele existente în zonă; – Raport de conformare NZEB, întocmit de auditor energetic pentru clădiri atestat; – Elaborarea documentaţiilor pentru obţinerea avizelor şi acordurilor solicitate prin Certificatul de Urbanism, precum şi asistenţă acordată Autorităţii contractante în vederea obţinerii avizelor, inclusiv Documentaţia pentru obţinerea acordului de principiu de securitate la incendiu şi documentaţia pentru obţinerea avizului privind sănătatea populaţiei. Totodată, Prestatorul va asigura suport de specialitate Autorităţii contractante la prezentarea documentaţiei tehnico-economice în vederea obţinerii avizului C.T.E. al M.Ap.N. (prezentare în format .pptx sau similar pentru susţinerea documentaţiei întocmite în vederea avizării şi aprobării în şedinţa Consiliului Tehnico-Economic al Ministerului Apărării Naţionale). De asemenea, la solicitarea Autorităţii contractante, Prestatorul acordă asistenţă tehnică de specialitate şi transmite clarificări cu privire la documentaţia tehnico-economică elaborată de acesta, pe durata promovării fazelor următoare ale proiectului (elaborare D.T.A.C., P.Th. + D.E., execuţie lucrări). Clarificările se transmit exclusiv Autorităţii contractante, care le valorifică potrivit competenţelor proprii. Prestatorul nu participă la derularea procedurilor de atribuire subsecvente şi nu are acces la ofertele depuse ori la identitatea operatorilor economici participanţi. Numărul de zile până la care se pot solicita clarificări înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor/candidaturilor: 12. AC va răspunde în mod clar și complet la toate solicitările de clarificări în conformitate cu prevederile art. 69 și 70 din O.U.G. 114/2011 cu modificările și completările ulterioare, dar nu mai târziu de 6 zile înainte de data-limită stabilită pentru depunerea ofertelor.

title: AFP for Lease of Discovery Park at Michoud Assembly Facility
description: This Announcement for Proposals (AFP) solicits proposals for lease of Discovery Park which represents a selection of available real property assets at MAF. The real property assets (The Property) known as Discovery Park, and shown in Exhibit A, are as follows: 1. Approximately 45 Acres of Greenspace: This tract of land lies on the northern extent of the facility and is bounded by Old Gentilly Road (publicly accessible roadway) as well as Mercury, Uranus and Venus Drives, which are interior to the security fencing. The acreage is currently classified as underutilized greenspace. The tract�s frontage to Old Gentilly Road has availability to direct connection with municipal power, potable water and sewer services. These utilities may be established with each respective service carrier. Please see Exhibit B for a listing of municipal resources which may assist in performing diligence for these service agreements. The acreage includes what were previously large sections of parking areas that supported a previously demolished building. These areas are past their useful service life and thus have been considered greenspace for appraisal purposes. 2. Building 351: Building 351 is an approximately 32,000 sf mixed used facility. The building is subdivided into two main areas: formal event space and cafeteria. The building currently is connected to the MAF utility grids. As a result, some determination will need to be made with respect to severing the building from those utilities and re-establishing utility services from the previously mentioned municipal service providers based upon the proposer�s concept of use. This reconfiguration would be made subject to NASA�s approval and terms of use. The Proposer may choose to propose on either asset separately or a combination of the two. NASA shall have the authority to execute either one or multiple leases in the event The Proposer chooses to include a combination of both assets in their submission. NASA intends to utilize Enhanced Use Lease authority as set forth in 51 U.S.C. 20145 as the sole means to enter into a lease(s) for The Property. The Proposer will assume any and all financial responsibilities for operations and maintenance of The Property under such a lease. The terms and conditions in the attached Model Enhanced Use Lease (EUL) generally demonstrate all the Proposer responsibilities including those maintenance and operational parameters. While The Property has existing utilities which serve other portions of the facility, the Proposer should not assume that any existing utilities will be available for use and that any utilities required for development will be at the sole cost of the Proposer. The Property will be available at award in �as is� condition for no less than one ten (10) year base term. title: South Haven and New Buffalo Maintenance Dredging
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Detroit District is seeking contractor with the capability to provide construction services for Maintenance Dredging for South Haven Harbor and New Buffalo Harbor. The project includes mobilize to dredge of both New Buffalo Harbor, located in Berrien County, Michigan and South Haven Habor, located in Van Buren County, Michigan. De-mobilize when dredging is completed. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATION OR DRAWING are available for this Notice. The Government intends to solicit this opportunity as an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The IFB is intended to be issued as a 100% Small Business Set Aside, and the Government intends to award to the lowest priced bid that is determined to be responsible. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this work is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which has a small business size standard of $37.0 million in average annual receipts with the Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities exception. General Information The Government intends to issue a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Construction Contract. The estimated anticipated Solicitation Posting Date: April 7, 2026 The estimated anticipated Bid Due Date: May 7, 2026 The estimated magnitude of construction is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The Product Service Code is Y1KF ? Construction of Dredging Facilities. The solicitation package materials, documents, drawings, specifications, and attachments to the anticipated solicitation will be available only electronically and via the System for Award Management (SAM). Contractors can access SAM free of charge at www.sam.gov. The solicitation posted on SAM.gov will include a link to all solicitation documents which will be stored in the Solicitation module of the Procurement Integrated enterprise Environment (PIEE) system. Contractors may register for PIEE free of charge at https://piee.eb.mil/. In order for interest contractors to conduct business with the Federal Government, contractors must be registered in PIEE prior to the bid due date and in SAM.gov prior to any award. Hard copy documents will NOT be supplied by the Government to any interested parties as a result of this Pre-Solicitation Notice or the upcoming Solicitation. Electronic bid submission will be required through the PIEE Solicitation Module suite at https://piee.eb.mil. Please note the Government will not be maintaining a bidder list during the solicitation period. However, vendors are strongly encouraged to review the ?Interest Vendor List? found on sam.gov for this requirement.

title: USCG REGIONAL MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (RMACC III) Vendor Outreach Matchmaking Event (VOME)
description: REGISTRATION IS NOW OPEN! USCG REGIONAL MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (NMACC III) VENDOR OUTREACH MATCHMAKING EVENT (VOME) On Wednesday, September 10, 2025, from 9:00 a.m. � 4:00 p.m. ET, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Office of Small and Disadvantaged Business Utilization (OSDBU) in collaboration with the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) will host a Vendor Outreach Matchmaking Event (VOME) for the third generation of the Regional Multiple Award Construction Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Contracts (RMACC III). This event will focus on matchmaking for small and other than small businesses that provide construction, architectural and engineering, and construction related services. Registration is be limited to those firms interested in the USCG RMACC III requirement as either a prime or subcontractor for any of the regions are encouraged to register for this event. Prior to registering, firms should review the active RMACC III Opportunity ID 70Z08725RRMACC003 and the published artifacts from the Virtual Industry Day (see links below). The table below reflects the planned set-aside by each region: Formerly July 2025 Name Change Planned Set-Aside District 1 USCG Northeast Region 8(a) District 5 USCG East Region SDVOSB District 7 USCG Southeast Region 8(a) District 7.5 USCG Southeast Region - Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands 100% SB District 8 USCG Heartland Region Total/100% SB District 9 USCG Great Lakes Region HUBZone District 11 USCG Southwest Region 8(a) District 13 USCG Northwest Region SDVOSB District 14 USCG Oceania Region 8(a) District 17 USCG Arctic Region HUBZone; 8(a) The RMACC III VOME will be held virtually to connect businesses in a variety of ways, which includes the discussion of potential subcontracting opportunities; forming joint-venture or teaming partnerships; and facilitating discussions that may lead to mentor-prot�g� relationships. This event provides a virtual space where both large and small businesses can present their core capabilities. Each meeting will be 15 minutes established by matching of core competencies and lines of businesses as identified by each firms North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code(s). Those small businesses that are primarily engaged in supplies/services under the following NAICS Sector and Subsectors should attend this event: 23 Construction 236 Construction of Buildings 237 Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction 238 Specialty Trade Contractors 532 Rental and Leasing Services (specifically, those relating to construction equipment rental and leasing services) 541 Professional, Scientific and Technical Services (specifically, those relating to architectural and engineering services) 562 Waste Management and Remediation Services (specifically, those relating to environmental remediation services) Registration is now open for the RMACC III VOME until 11:59 PM EDT, Monday, September 8, 2025. All firms can begin to request meetings on Monday, August 25, 2025. The delay between registration and the date to request meetings is to allow for a robust database of participating firms. We encourage businesses to upload their capability statements when registering for the RMACC III VOME. Each registrant will request to meet with other businesses that align with services or products they provide or are seeking. Registration does not guarantee a meeting and each business will decide which requests meet their needs by acceptance of the meeting request(s). What This Event Is: � Virtual one-on-one 15-minute meeting(s) between two (large to small or small to small) businesses. � An opportunity to present capabilities and to have potential discussions outside of the VOME. � An opportunity for small businesses to establish a relationship with large or other small businesses currently doing business with DHS or other federal agencies and/or actively seeking opportunities. What This Event Is NOT: � A virtual Vendor Outreach Session. There are no meetings with DHS Small Business Specialists. � A webinar event or training. All small and large businesses are required to register at https://mbmapp.com/event/rmaccvome2025 and provide the required information including a capability statement and a valid point of contact email address in their profile compatible with various virtual meeting tools (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx, etc.). Once your firm receives confirmation of a meeting from the scheduling site, you will receive a follow-up email with the virtual meeting invitation. If you do not see a meeting invitation, check your spam or junk mail folders. A platform tutorial is also being provided in this notice outlining the registration and meeting process. Please be advised that if connectivity issues occur using the virtual tools, the session may be conducted telephonically or rescheduled. Questions on the RMACC III VOME should be sent to OSDBU.VOS@hq.dhs.gov.

description: Le projet de contournement de la ville du Locle est un nouvel aménagement et consiste en un évitement en tunnel par le Nord (un tube bidirectionnel avec galerie de sécurité), qui débute vers la gare du Col des Roches (site de la carrière des Granges) pour aboutir à la jonction existante du Crêt-du-Locle. title: Netherlands – Storage and warehousing services – Externe geconditioneerde opslag van samples (as-a-service)
description: Europese aanbesteding voor de aanschaf van externe geconditioneerde opslag van samples (as-a-service) voor het RIVM. De aanbesteding heeft tot doel opslagcapaciteit te realiseren, zodat de door RIVM in stand te houden Collecties, onder de voor deze Collecties noodzakelijke condities, bewaard kunnen worden. De Overeenkomst heeft een standaard looptijd van 10 jaar, inclusief eventuele verlengingen is de maximale looptijd in totaal 15 jaar. De Opdracht is opgedeeld in twee percelen: Perceel 1 (basisperceel): Dit perceel omvat de opslag, beheer en logistieke dienstverlening waarbij opvraag plaatsvindt op doos- of kratniveau (of een soortgelijk niveau). Het vernietigen en afvoeren van Samples in opvraageenheden wordt binnen perceel 1 als optionele dienstverlening uitgevraagd. Inschrijvers zijn niet verplicht deze dienstverlening aan te bieden. Indien Opdrachtnemer deze dienstverlening aanbiedt, dient deze te worden uitgevoerd conform de daarvoor geldende wet- en regelgeving. Perceel 2 (geavanceerd perceel): Dit perceel omvat opslag, beheer en logistieke dienstverlening waarbij opvraag plaatsvindt op doos- of kratniveau (of een soortgelijk niveau) danwel op individueel sampleniveau. Daarnaast zijn vernietiging en afvoeren van Samples in Opvraageenheden op verzoek van Opdrachtgever, conform de daarvoor geldende wet- en regelgeving van Samples, en het op verzoek van Opdrachtgever uitvoeren van professionaliseringswerkzaamheden voor (delen van) Collecties onderdeel van de gevraagde dienstverlening. https://www.rivm.nl/contact/zakendoen-met-rivm

description: ATVIRAS PROJEKTO KONKURSAS. Tauralaukio rajono teritorijos, pagal Klaipėdos miesto bendrojo plano sprendinius patenkančios į 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.8 ir 9.9 nagrinėjamus rajonus, urbanistinės idėjos atviras projekto konkursas. Projekto konkurso tikslas - išrinkti geriausiai urbanistinius, architektūros ir funkcinius aspektus bei kitus reikalavimus, išvardintus konkurso sąlygose, atitinkančią Tauralaukio rajono teritorijos, pagal Klaipėdos miesto bendrojo plano sprendinius patenkančios į 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.8 ir 9.9 nagrinėjamus rajonus, urbanistinės idėjos projektą, kurio pagrindu ateityje bus rengiami teritorijų planavimo dokumentai ir vystoma ši Tauralaukio rajono teritorija. Biudžetas: šio projekto konkurso pirkimo objekto įgyvendinimui (t.y. urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimui) suplanuota suma - 50 000 Eur su PVM (41 322,31 Eur be PVM). Vadovaujantis VPĮ 55 str. 3 d. Perkančioji organizacija konkurso dokumentuose iš anksto nustato fiksuotą kainą projekto konkurso pirkimo objekto įgyvendinimui (t.y. urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimui) - 50 000 Eur su PVM (arba 41 322,31 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar paslaugos neapmokestinamos PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių, dėl kurių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM). Projekto konkurso pirmąsias 3 vietas užėmusius dalyvius numatyta apdovanoti piniginiais prizais (premijomis), skiriant 40 000 Eur, prizinį fondą išskirstant tokia seka: I vieta – 16 000 Eur; II vieta – 14 000 Eur; III vieta – 10 000 Eur. Perkančioji organizacija laimėjusiu nustato tik 1 (vieną) dalyvį, surinkusį daugiausiai balų ir esantį pirmoje vietoje, neatitikusį pašalinimo pagrindų ir atitikusį nustatytus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. Su projekto konkurso laimėtoju numatoma sudaryti paslaugų pirkimo–pardavimo sutartį dėl urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimo.

Biudžetas: šio projekto konkurso pirkimo objekto įgyvendinimui (t.y. urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimui) suplanuota suma - 50 000 Eur su PVM (41 322,31 Eur be PVM). Vadovaujantis VPĮ 55 str. 3 d. Perkančioji organizacija konkurso dokumentuose iš anksto nustato fiksuotą kainą projekto konkurso pirkimo objekto įgyvendinimui (t.y. urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimui) - 50 000 Eur su PVM (arba 41 322,31 Eur be PVM, jei tiekėjas yra ne PVM mokėtojas ar paslaugos neapmokestinamos PVM, ar dėl kitų priežasčių, dėl kurių Perkančiosios organizacijos galutinė tiekėjui mokėtina suma bus be PVM). Projekto konkurso pirmąsias 3 vietas užėmusius dalyvius numatyta apdovanoti piniginiais prizais (premijomis), skiriant 40 000 Eur, prizinį fondą išskirstant tokia seka: I vieta – 16 000 Eur; II vieta – 14 000 Eur; III vieta – 10 000 Eur. Perkančioji organizacija laimėjusiu nustato tik 1 (vieną) dalyvį, surinkusį daugiausiai balų ir esantį pirmoje vietoje, neatitikusį pašalinimo pagrindų ir atitikusį nustatytus kvalifikacijos reikalavimus. Su projekto konkurso laimėtoju numatoma sudaryti paslaugų pirkimo–pardavimo sutartį dėl urbanistinės koncepcijos parengimo.

title: JBLM Catholic Priest Services
description: The contractor shall provide all personnel, equipment, supplies, facilities, transportation, tools, materials, supervision, and other items and non-personal services necessary to perform the duties of Catholic Priest as defined in this Performance Work Statement (PWS) except for those items specified as government furnished property and services. The Contractor shall advise the Government Chaplaincy personnel as the Catholic subject matter expert (SME). The Contractor shall serve as the SME on Catholic religious instruction in compliance with the conformity listing maintained by the AMS.

title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Lipegfilgrastim, (OBO) ATC L03AA14 für die Zeit 01.02.2025 - 31.01.2027
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff, Lipegfilgrastim, ATC L03AA14, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.02.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.01.2027. Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.

Součástí stavby je také vybudování 2 úrovňových křižovatek, 6 přeložek komunikací nižších kategorií, 2 příjezdy k retenčním nádržím, sjezdy a provizorní komunikace objízdných tras. Dále jsou nedílnou součástí stavby vodohospodářské objekty, přeložky dotčených inženýrských sítí, zřízení násypových těles, protihlukových stěn.

title: Switzerland – Construction work – NKM 5.1 – Los «All-inclusive», Fahrbahnerneuerungen 2029-2033, Rahmenvertrag GU, Schweiz
description: Le présent appel d'offres porte sur des prestations d'entrepreneur général en Suisse alémanique, romande et italienne sous forme d'un contrat-cadre. La durée du contrat est de trois ans, avec une option de prolongation de deux ans supplémentaires. L'objet du mandat porte sur des travaux de renouvellement de la voie ferrée et d’appareils de voie avec criblage du ballast (SR), remplacement du ballast (SE) et assainissement de l’infrastructure (UBS). Le soumissionnaire doit être en mesure de réaliser les projets de renouvellement de la voie en tant qu’entrepreneur général (EG). En règle générale, l’attribution du mandat intervient à partir de la phase partielle SIA 51 (projet d’exécution). Dans certains cas, l’implication préalable de l’entreprise est nécessaire afin d’établir la planification des phases de construction pendant les phases partielles 31-33. Il n’existe aucune obligation d’achat pour CFF SA (aucune prétention quant à l’atteinte du montant du contrat d’ici à la fin de la durée contractuelle, option comprise). Contenu de ces lots : Type/genre : Tous les types de travaux de rénovation, tels que le criblage du ballast (SR), le remplacement du ballast (SE) et assainissement de la plateforme ferroviaire (UBS) pour les voies et les appareils de voie, axés sur le criblage du ballast, dans toute la Suisse. Réalisation en tant qu'entrepreneur général ou total. Description : Lot général pour des projets de voies ferrées (comprenant en partie des appareils de voie) d'une longueur comprise entre environ 1 000 m et 9 000 m maximum. Des travaux de génie civil sont également à réaliser. Le criblage du ballast doit pouvoir être effectué pour des largeurs standard allant jusqu’à 450 cm et, pour des espaces restreints (tunnels, ponts, zones de quais, etc.), avec une largeur de passage < 320 cm. Volume/quantité : Volume annuel total d'env. 20 à 40 km pour SR, SE et UBS, dont environ 15 à 30 km/an de criblage de ballast. Quantité minimale d'achat annuelle garantie de 20 km/an au total , dont 15 km/an de criblage de ballast. Le volume annuel théorique maximal correspond au double de la quantité minimale d'achat, soit 40 km/an de SR, SE et UBS. Cette valeur est déterminante pour le rabais sur les quantités supplémentaires. Adjudications : Deux adjudications. Quantités minimales d'achat garanties pour le soumissionnaire placé en tête du classement (au moins 20 km/an au total SR/UBS, dont min. 15 km/an de criblage du ballast). Pas de quantités minimales garanties pour le soumissionnaire classé en deuxième rang (le rabais échelonné s’applique) Une offre est valable pour les deux rangs d’adjudication (premier et deuxième classés). Il n’est pas possible de déposer une offre limitée à la quantité minimale d’achat garantie.
